originals.ko: 여러분 그 일들을 열 수 있어요?
originals.why: pethau is taught as 일들 (tasks/matters), and you can't 'open' those. The Welsh only makes sense with 'things' meaning objects, so with this gloss the Korean prompt is unnatural.

originals.ko: 실례지만, 그걸 지금 다시 말해 주실 수 있어요? 저는 확실히 할 필요가 있어요.
실례지만, 그걸 다시 말해 주실 수 있어요? 저는 확실히 할 필요가 있어요.

originals.why: symud is taught as 이사하다 (move house). Here it means moving your hands, which this course never taught. A Korean prompt that uses the gloss ('손을 이사하다') is nonsense, and using 움직이다 brings in a known word the learner never got.

originals.ko: 부탁해요, 여러분 지금 앉을 수 있어요?
여러분 손을 위아래로 움직일 수 있어요?
originals.why: Same problem as o6: symud is taught as 이사하다 (move house), not as moving your hands.
